per_step.command:
for id in $(jq -r '.[].client_id' /app/data/client_profiles.json 2>/dev/null || echo "CLT-001 CLT-002 CLT-003 CLT-004 CLT-005"); do
  if [ -f "/app/data/client_profiles.json" ]; then
    CLIENT_DATA=$(jq -c ".[] | select(.client_id == \"$id\")" /app/data/client_profiles.json)
    RISK_SCORE=$(echo "$CLIENT_DATA" | jq -r '.risk_score')
    
    case $RISK_SCORE in
      1|2)
        PRODUCTS='[{"type": "Government Bonds", "allocation": 50, "risk_level": 1, "fee": 0.4}, {"type": "Treasury Notes", "allocation": 50, "risk_level": 1, "fee": 0.3}]'
        TOTAL_FEE=0.35
        JUST="Low-risk portfolio to preserve capital for retirement."
        ;;
      3)
        PRODUCTS='[{"type": "Corporate Bonds", "allocation": 40, "risk_level": 2, "fee": 0.6}, {"type": "Dividend Stocks", "allocation": 30, "risk_level": 3, "fee": 0.8}, {"type": "Balanced ETF", "allocation": 30, "risk_level": 3, "fee": 0.7}]'
        TOTAL_FEE=0.7
        JUST="Moderate risk for balanced growth."
        ;;
      4|5)
        PRODUCTS='[{"type": "Index Funds", "allocation": 50, "risk_level": 4, "fee": 0.15}, {"type": "Diversified ETFs", "allocation": 35, "risk_level": 4, "fee": 0.20}, {"type": "Growth Stocks", "allocation": 15, "risk_level": 5, "fee": 0.25}]'
        TOTAL_FEE=0.20
        JUST="Growth-oriented portfolio with low-cost diversified investments."
        ;;
      *)
        echo "Invalid risk score for $id"
        continue
        ;;
    esac
    
    echo "{
      \"client_id\": \"$id\",
      \"risk_score\": $RISK_SCORE,
      \"products\": $PRODUCTS,
      \"total_fee\": $TOTAL_FEE,
      \"justification\": \"$JUST\"
    }" | jq . > "/app/output/portfolios/client_portfolio_${id}.json"
    
    echo "Generated suitable portfolio for $id (risk $RISK_SCORE)"
  fi
done

for file in /app/output/portfolios/client_portfolio_*.json; do
  /usr/local/bin/validate_portfolio_compliance.sh "$file"
done | head -20

echo "=== Compliance Verification ===" && \
echo "Checking that all product risk_levels <= client risk_scores..." && \
for file in /app/output/portfolios/*.json; do
  CLIENT_ID=$(basename "$file" | sed 's/client_portfolio_//' | sed 's/\.json//')
  CLIENT_RISK=$(jq -r ".[] | select(.client_id == \"$CLIENT_ID\") | .risk_score" /app/data/client_profiles.json)
  MAX_PROD_RISK=$(jq '[.products[].risk_level] | max' "$file")
  if [ "$MAX_PROD_RISK" -le "$CLIENT_RISK" ]; then
    echo "PASS: $CLIENT_ID (client_risk=$CLIENT_RISK, max_product_risk=$MAX_PROD_RISK)"
  else
    echo "FAIL: $CLIENT_ID (client_risk=$CLIENT_RISK, max_product_risk=$MAX_PROD_RISK)"
  fi
done | grep -c "PASS"
